description: Sri Lanka Council of Archaeologists - Amended, Sri Lanka Council of Archaeologists Act, No. 4 of 1992 (Incorporated)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the repeal of an existing set of rules and the enactment of a new constitution/ruleset for the Sri Lanka Council of Archaeologists under the Sri Lanka Council of Archaeologists Act, No. 4 of 1992. It establishes regulatory frameworks, membership criteria, and professional standards for archaeologists, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government structure, personnel, or other specialized categories.
